description: Guards the visible label of the Triggers-tab catalog-entry button that both `teach-promptless-a-custom-task.mdx`'s and `teach-promptless-a-custom-task/review-inbound-doc-prs.mdx`'s '## Configure the trigger' steps send the reader to click. The button was recently renamed, so this spec asserts the new label is live and the old one is gone -- a reader following either guide could otherwise be told to click a control that no longer exists under that name.

tests.description: Confirms the Configuration page's Triggers tab shows the catalog-entry button under its current label and not its previous one.

steps.description: Navigate to the Clerk sign-in page
Wait for the password page to load
Open the Configuration page, which both guides send the reader to
Wait for the Triggers tab's catalog-entry button to render under its current label

Exactly one control carries the documented current label, and none carries the previous label. Matched on exact visible text among the page's buttons/links, so a partial rename or a stale rollout of either label would be caught.

runBrowserScript.script: const controls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="button"]')); const norm = (el) => (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const newLabelCount = controls.filter((el) => norm(el) === 'Add an automatic or scheduled trigger').length; const oldLabelCount = controls.filter((el) => norm(el) === 'Add a trigger').length; return ['newLabel=' + newLabelCount, 'oldLabel=' + oldLabelCount].join(' ');
